svg.title: UC4 — Booking + Payment (email OTP + Stripe confirm)

g.text: UC4 — Booking + Payment (email OTP + Stripe confirm)
Verify email ownership (before payment is allowed)
submit button stays disabled until emailVerified
fill guest + billing details, card (Stripe CardElement)
raw PAN/CVV never reach our server
wrapped in try/catch — a points failure never fails the booking
